hero.greeting: Hi! I'm Rizqiansyah Ramadhan, a Software Engineer with experience in full-stack development, backend systems, and production infrastructure.
hero.paragraph1: My interest in software development began with a curiosity about how applications work behind the scenes, particularly how frontend interfaces, backend services, and databases connect. Over time, that curiosity grew into hands-on experience building web and mobile applications, developing APIs, and maintaining production systems.
hero.paragraph2: My work covers application development, API integration, database management, and deployment. I work with technologies such as {techStack}, along with PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, depending on project requirements.
hero.techStack: Go, TypeScript, Laravel, Vue.js, and Flutter
hero.paragraph3: Beyond development, I also work with Linux servers and production infrastructure, including monitoring, DNS, SSL/TLS, and troubleshooting. I value maintainable code, practical problem-solving, and continuous learning. I also use AI-assisted development tools to support research, debugging, and development workflows.
